$comment: Repository-level settings. raw_base_url is where the built bundles and icons will be served from — build.mjs turns it into each source's entry_url and icon_url in index.json. Change it once here after you create the GitHub repo; override it for a tunnel with RAW_BASE_URL=... npm run build. Everything under "repository" is copied into index.json verbatim so the app can name and attribute this repo in its UI.

repository.name: ProjektManga sources
repository.description: Sandboxed manga sources maintained alongside ProjektManga.
